title: fix(ui): bound the disabled-reason tooltip width on declared actions and quick actions
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnE9YNkSZen7sijLA3

Fixes #29954

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录页操作栏、record:quick_actions 以及 action:* 渲染器(按钮/图标/分组/菜单)里置灰操作的「不可用原因」提示框加了最大宽度,长原因会换行。
- 为什么改:手机宽度(390px)下提示框被渲染成约 727px 一行,右侧被截断,作者写的原因读不全。
- 风险与回滚:三处各只加一个 Tailwind 类 max-w-xs,与首页同类提示框一致;回滚即删该类。
- 先看:ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DeclaredActionsBar.tsx 的 TooltipContent 一行;其次 plugin-detail 的 record-quick-actions.tsx 与 components 的 renderers/action/disabled-reason.tsx 同形各一行。
- 两分钟验证:在 ui 根目录跑 pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/DeclaredActionsBar.disabledReason-26619.test.tsx packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-quick-actions.disabledReason-26619.test.tsx packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-disabled-reason-26619.test.tsx,预期全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `DeclaredActionsBar.tsx`: the disabled-reason `TooltipContent` gets `className="max-w-xs"`.
- `record-quick-actions.tsx`: the same-shape `record:quick_actions` disabled tooltip has the identical gap and gets the identical class.
- Changeset `.changeset/29954-disabled-reason-tooltip-width.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, patch).

Local class instead of the shared `TooltipContent` primitive: the primitive sits in `ui/packages/components` and every tooltip in the console inherits it, so a default cap there changes tooltips this card never looked at. The home page already bounds its tooltip locally, so this follows that precedent.

## Tests

One new case in each of the three existing `disabledReason-26619` test file: hover the greyed action, then assert the tooltip's painted box (the ancestor of Radix's visually-hidden `role=tooltip` node) carries `max-w-xs`. Ablation (fix committed first, class removed, test files run): app-shell and plugin-detail 2 failed, 8 passed; components (disabled-reason.tsx) 3 failed, 24 passed (the three button sites). Each restored with `git checkout HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty. Restored: app-shell + plugin-detail 10 of 10, components 27 of 27.

## Acceptance notes

Read: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx` (the card says `HomePage.tsx`; the file is under `console/home/`, line with `<TooltipContent className="max-w-xs">{disabledReason}</TooltipContent>`, so the PM's unconfirmed `max-w-xs` assumption holds), `DeclaredActionsBar.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-quick-actions.tsx`, `ui/packages/components/src/ui/tooltip.tsx` (no width default), `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/disabled-reason.tsx`.

`disabled-reason.tsx` was first reported as a follow-up and folded into this PR on the coordinator's rework order (file surface widened by that file and its test).

## Verification

Dispatch-derived gates: 35 families, 34 run exit 0 each (including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`), plus `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (170 files passed, 2 skipped). `--ran` reconciliation: 35 derived, 35 run. Type-check of the three packages: NOT MEASURED locally (the ui dependency closure is not built here; tsc reports TS2307 on workspace imports), left to the Type Check UI check-run.
